{{Short description|Polish mathematician}}

'''Anna Maria Zdunik''' is a Polish [[mathematician]]. She specializes in [[dynamical system]]s, and is a professor at the [[University of Warsaw]].<ref name=":0">{{cite web | url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=56648&_k=0sm42a | title=Nowa Nauka Polska }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://usosweb.uw.edu.pl/kontroler.php?_action=katalog2/osoby/pokazOsobe&os_id=519|title=Anna Zdunik - Studenci, pracownicy - Uniwersytet Warszawski - USOSweb|website=usosweb.uw.edu.pl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mimuw.edu.pl/osoba/519|title=Anna Zdunik &#124; MIMUW|website=www.mimuw.edu.pl}}</ref>

==Education==
Zdunik earned her [[habilitation]] in 2002, on the basis of an evaluation of her achievements and her [[dissertation]].<ref name=":0" />

==Career==
She became a [[professor]] of mathematics in 2010.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z dnia 23 grudnia 2010 r. nr 115-9-10 w sprawie nadania tytułu profesora |url=https://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20110090082 |access-date=2022-06-24 |website=isap.sejm.gov.pl}}</ref>

She was invited as a speaker for the 2015 [[Fields Medal Symposium]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.fields.utoronto.ca/talks/thermodynamic-formalism-iteration-holomorphic-maps|title=Thermodynamic formalism for iteration of holomorphic maps|date=November 20, 2015|website=Fields Institute for Research in Mathematical Sciences}}</ref>

She is the Chair of the Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics and Mechanics of the [[University of Warsaw]] (MIMUW).<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=http://wcmcs.edu.pl/node/36|title=The Structure|website=wcmcs.edu.pl}}</ref> The Warsaw Center of Mathematics and Computer Science (Warszawskie Centrum Nauk Matematycznych) is a project of both MIMUW and the [[Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences]] (IMPAN); the center is run by an executive committee that includes Zdunik.<ref name="auto"/>

* {{cite journal|doi=10.1017/S0013091505000179|title=Maximizing Measures on Metrizable Non-Compact Spaces|year=2007|last1=Davie|first1=Alexander M.|last2=Urbański|first2=Mariusz|last3=Zdunik|first3=Anna|author-link= Alexander Munro Davie|journal=Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society|volume=50|pages=123–151|s2cid=122852202|doi-access=free}} 2007
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1017/S0143385711000290|title=Bowen's formula for [[meromorphic function]]s|year=2012|last1=Barański|first1=Krzysztof|last2=Karpińska|first2= Bogusława|last3=Zdunik|first3=Anna|journal=[[Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems]]|volume=32|issue=4 |pages=1165–1189|arxiv=1007.3855 |s2cid=119134381 }} 2012
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1017/S0305004116000049|title=Regularity of Hausdorff measure function for conformal dynamical systems|year=2016|last1=Urbański|first1=Mariusz|last2=Zdunik|first2=Anna|journal=[[Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society|Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society]]|volume=160|issue=3 |pages=537–563|bibcode=2016MPCPS.160..537U |s2cid=18940251 }} 2016
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1017/etds.2018.42|title=Real analyticity for random dynamics of [[transcendental function]]s|year=2020|last1=Mayer|first1=Volker|last2=Urbański|first2=Mariusz|last3=Zdunik|first3=Anna|journal=[[Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems]]|volume=40|issue=2 |pages=490–520|arxiv=1603.05415 |s2cid=73624072 }} 2020
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1017/etds.2020.148|title=Total disconnectedness of [[Julia set]]s of random quadratic polynomials|year=2022|last1=Lech|first1=Krzysztof|last2=Zdunik|first2=Anna|journal=[[Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems]]|volume=42|issue=5 |pages=1764–1780|arxiv=2004.06955 |s2cid=215768598 }} 2022
